findings.title: Experiment metric contract does not verify its re-derived value
findings.what: The fixture states that 3 blocking foreground calls over 3 tool calls must produce 100 BFC per 100 tool calls, but asserts only `meanMetric > 0`. Incorrect normalization, denominators, or scale factors would still pass while the test claims to prove the full ingest-to-measure path.
findings.fix: Replace the positivity assertion with an exact assertion for 100, or a tightly justified floating-point comparison if the calculation is intentionally non-integral.
findings.acceptance: With the current fixture, the test asserts `v.arms.on.meanMetric === 100`; a deliberate mutation that returns another positive value such as 1 or 50 makes the test fail.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial second pass re-read scripts/experiments-route.test.mjs:187-223. The fixture contains exactly three qualifying calls and explicitly derives 100 at line 210, while line 211 checks only positivity; no adjacent assertion constrains the numeric result.
